description: This file defines the RouteParser interface within the FastRoute namespace. It specifies a method for parsing route strings into structured route data arrays, including detailed comments and an example of the parsing logic.

classes.name: RouteParser
classes.description: An interface that declares the parse method for converting route strings into route data arrays.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a route string into multiple route data arrays, supporting placeholders and optional parts as described in the comments.
